differences.aspect: hidden random source and repeated object calls
differences.native: LeetCode constructs Solution(n, blacklist); each pick() obtains a hidden randrange(bound) draw.
differences.app: solve(n, blacklist, draws) defines randrange(bound) over the authored integer tickets and calls the same pick calculation once per ticket.
differences.rationale: The offline judge must expose randomness and a finite call count. Blacklist preprocessing, low-to-high remapping, raw ticket lookup, uniform-domain bijection, and expected constant-time picks are identical after the deterministic random-source adapter.
